# S99 — Live role detail: output tail and tokens/cost in the run pane

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

S07 (landed) delivered the stage bar, ticker and sparkline, but not the output tail or tokens and cost that its title promised. Owner 2026-10-24: tail and tokens/cost in v1; the bell moves to v1.1 (S100). Today tokens and cost are recorded per role round when it ends (runrec.RoleRecord, internal/runrec/record.go:61-62; engine.Result Tokens and CostUSD, internal/engine/runner.go:64-65), so a running role shows neither; the claude adapter keeps a 2 KB tail per round (internal/agent/claude/run.go:20-21, Round.Tail) but nothing streams it to the TUI. The tail can contain secrets (a recorded command can, see S51): it must stay in daemon memory, never in run.json.

## Files

- `internal/engine/runner.go` (Request): extend the per-event hook (S07 added `OnEvent func()`) or add a sibling so the engine can keep the last N bytes of the role's visible output text and the running token total; `internal/agent/claude/run.go`, `internal/agent/codex/codex.go` and `internal/daemon/runner.go`: pass text deltas and usage events through.
- `internal/engine/activity.go` (S07): keep the tail and the live token and cost counters beside the activity ring, in memory only, with the same mutex.
- `internal/source/source.go` (EngineRun) and `internal/daemon/runs.go` (engineRuns): carry `tail` (last 2 KB, redacted of the run environment) and `tokens` and `cost_usd` for the running role as *proposed* fields.
- `internal/tui/runtree.go`, `relayboard.go`, `overview.go`: the pane shows the tail under the running node (a few lines, dim, clipped to the width) and a tokens and cost line; the Running row shows the token total.
- Tests beside each, `testdata/golden/`, `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/state.md` (state that the tail is never written to disk).

## Failing tests

- TestTailKeepsTheLastBytesOfVisibleText: text deltas fill a ring capped at 2 KB; older text is dropped; the ring is reset at each new role round.
- TestTailNeverReachesRunJSON: the run record and report files contain no tail text.
- TestLiveTokensAndCostAccumulate: usage events update the running totals before the round ends; the final Result still sets the RoleRecord values.
- TestPaneShowsTheTailAndTokens: the running node shows up to 3 dim tail lines clipped to the pane width and `tokens N  $C`; a finished role shows its recorded values; no tail for stopped or ended runs.
- TestRunningRowShowsTheTokenTotal and the narrow-row drop order (bar and heard stay first to go).
- TestAdaptersMapTextAndUsageEvents (claude and codex fixtures).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

## Implement

Keep the tail and counters in memory beside the activity ring. 4. Carry them on the snapshot. 5. Draw them. 6. Update the docs. 7. go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff. This is a UI slice: it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10). Open for the preflight to settle with the owner: how many tail lines, whether the tail shows tool calls or only assistant text, and a redaction rule. Decided 2026-10-24 (owner): tail and tokens/cost in v1; bell to v1.1.
